reviewedFrom: EP06-01 through EP06-05 (docs/enterprise-production/completion-checklist.json) and the EP06 owner decisions of 2026-10-12: consultant and studio-room capacity enforced in the database with working hours per consultant and buyer notices on book, reschedule and cancel; a buyer approval (e-sign, portal, or in person with the signed copy) binds the exact options and prices sent, a change after sending voids it, and unsigned, sent, declined, expired and approved stay distinct; cutoffs are enforced inside the selection write in the community's day with home-scoped override authority; option lead times and released procurement close an option early and open a persisted exception with alternates; an approved selection change order lands the agreement version, selections, owning purchase order variance, budget revision and a pending schedule impact in one transaction, and voids the buyer's earlier approval of those selections.
